name: Twilio Segment Engage
description: Twilio Segment Engage builds audiences and customer engagement workflows on Segment's unified customer profiles and event data.
agentUseSummary: Connect a workspace-scoped read-only Segment Public API token and select the documented US or EU origin. Relay mounts three exact Engage reads: one space read runs directly, while audience listing and exact audience inspection require approval.

credentialRequirements.name: TWILIO_SEGMENT_ENGAGE_API_TOKEN
credentialRequirements.label: Segment Public API token
credentialRequirements.helpText: Use a dedicated workspace-scoped token with Profiles and Engage read-only permissions.

credentialRequirements.name: TWILIO_SEGMENT_ENGAGE_HEALTH_SPACE_ID
credentialRequirements.label: Segment staging space ID
credentialRequirements.helpText: Use one non-production Engage space for bounded health verification.

capabilities.label: Read Engage space
capabilities.description: Read one exact space's structural metadata.

capabilities.label: Read Engage audiences
capabilities.description: List or inspect audience definitions and sizes with approval.

allowed.label: Read Segment Engage space
allowed.description: Read one exact Engage space's structural metadata.

approvalRequired.label: Read Segment Engage audiences
approvalRequired.description: List or inspect audience definitions and sizes.

blocked.label: Expose credentials
blocked.description: Workspace API tokens, authorization headers, and credential-bearing fields never enter agent-visible inputs or results.

blocked.label: Read or export profiles
blocked.description: Profile traits, identities, events, audience members, Profiles Sync, warehouses, exports, pagination cursors, and bulk transfers are excluded.

blocked.label: Send or mutate engagement
blocked.description: Audience creation/updates/deletes/runs/previews/schedules, journeys, campaigns, email, SMS, subscriptions, destinations, sources, filters, and workspace administration remain provider-side.

blocked.label: Use arbitrary APIs
blocked.description: Only three pinned GET routes run on an enumerated US or EU Public API origin; arbitrary paths, regions, queries, include expansions, headers, and oversized results are blocked.

approvalProfiles.label: Safe
approvalProfiles.description: One exact space metadata read runs directly; audience lists and exact audience definitions require approval while workspace token, region, route, collection, and response bounds remain enforced.

approvalProfiles.label: Dangerously skip permissions
approvalProfiles.description: All three selected reads run without Relay per-action approval; workspace-scoped authority, fixed regional origins, exact IDs, response bounds, audits, and profile/export/send/mutation/admin blocks remain enforced.

runtimeSupport.description: Railway attaches the encrypted workspace token server-side and mounts three bounded regional Engage reads.
Railway attaches the encrypted workspace token server-side and mounts three bounded regional Engage reads.

providerSetup.blocker: Twilio Segment Engage requires a customer workspace with Engage/Audiences enabled, a dedicated Public API token with Profiles and Engage read-only authority, a regional binding, and a non-production space. No console, workspace, token, space, audience, profile, event, Railway environment, or deployment is allowed in this worker.
providerSetup.nextAction: Create a dedicated read-only staging token outside this worker, bind its US or EU region and staging space in Railway staging, then verify workspace isolation, health-space/audience reads, permission and approval denial/allow, region mismatch, response bounds, documented rate limits, token revocation, pause/disconnect, and post-disconnect denial.

evidence.supports: Segment documents workspace-scoped Public API tokens, token permissions and revocation, HTTPS-only bearer authentication, and one token per workspace.
Segment documents the fixed api.segmentapis.com US and eu1.api.segmentapis.com EU origins and distinguishes Public API tokens from Config API tokens.
Segment documents exact space GET and explains spaces as isolated Personas environments recommended for development/production separation.
Segment documents exact list/get audience routes, audience definitions, sizes and status, feature enablement, collection limits, and route-specific rate limits.
